\begin{codebox}{Box 5}{Draw the groups on a circle}
layout = karate.layout_circle(order=np.argsort(leiden))
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ig.plot(
    karate, target=ax, layout=layout,
    vertex_color=[palette[g] for g in leiden],
    vertex_shape=[shapes[g] for g in leiden],
    vertex_label=karate.vs.indices,
    vertex_label_color="white",
    edge_color="lightgray",
)
ax.set_title("Leiden, on a circle")
plt.show()
\end{codebox}
\begin{linenotes}
\item[1] \texttt{np.argsort(leiden)} lists the node numbers sorted by group, so that nodes of one group sit together. \texttt{layout\_circle(order=...)} puts the nodes on a circle in that order, so that each group takes one arc. The layout is a position for every node.
\item[2] A fresh empty panel.
\item[3--10] The drawing call of Box 2 again, with two additions: \texttt{layout=layout} uses our positions instead of igraph's own, and \texttt{edge\_color="lightgray"} draws the friendships in light grey, so that they do not hide the nodes.
\item[11--12] A title, and show the picture.
